<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def bboxes(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('B','c','Y') and n['pixels']>20:
            b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b); r1=max(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b); c1=max(p[1] for p in b)
            if r1>=63 or c1>=63: continue
            out.append((n['color'], r0,c0,r1,c1))
    return out
print("start:", bboxes(current_frame))
for a in ['LEFT','RIGHT','UP','DOWN']:
    action([a])
    r=last_action_result
    if r.get('level_completed') or r.get('done'): print("STOP",a,r); break
    print(a,"->",bboxes(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
